strings.Anh Khôi hậm hực nhưng đành tìm người th: Khôi fumes but has to find a replacement: the rest-hours rules are on your side.
strings.“Tết này cậu trực liền năm ngày nhé, ngư: “This Tết you’ll be on duty five days straight, everyone else has gone home.”
strings.“Tết nào chả thế, ráng đi em.”: “Every Tết is like this, hang in there.”
strings.“Chú về đất liền khám mắt hai hôm. Con t: “I’m going to the mainland for two days for an eye check. Can you cover my two night shifts?”
strings.Chú Bảy cười buồn: “Thôi để chú nhờ xí n: Uncle Bảy smiles sadly: “Never mind, I’ll ask the company to send someone.”
strings.Sơn lại tháp cuối tuần: Repainting the tower on the weekend
strings.“Tháp tróc sơn rồi. Cậu tranh thủ bốn ng: “The tower paint is peeling. Use your four days off to repaint it, the company will pay extra.”
strings.“Sơn thôi mà, có gì khó.”: “It’s just painting, how hard can it be.”
strings.“Ai cũng phải gánh thêm việc.”: “Everybody has to take on extra work.”
strings.Má xin gửi lương về sớm: Mom asks you to send pay early
strings.“Nhà mình đang cần tiền sửa mái. Con gửi: “We need money to fix the roof. Can you send three months of pay in advance?”
strings.“Má biết con cực, mà nhà đang khó.”: “Mom knows it’s hard for you, but we’re struggling.”
strings.Má nghe con giải thích, thở dài: “Ừ, gửi: Mom listens to your explanation and sighs: “Okay, send whatever you can.”
strings.Má buồn, cúp máy ngang. Tối đó má nhắn:: Mom is sad and hangs up abruptly. That night she texts: “Never mind, Mom will manage.”
strings.Cầu hôn trên đỉnh tháp lúc nửa đêm: Proposal at the top of the tower at midnight
strings.Mười một giờ đêm. Một cặp đôi gõ cửa trạ: Eleven at night. A couple knocks on the station door, the guy holds out a ring box: “Let me take her up to the gallery for just ten minutes, it’s once in a lifetime!”
strings.Bạn là chàng trai: bạn lên kế hoạch cả n: You are the guy: you planned for a whole year, the boat has gone back to shore, and she’s standing right behind you.
strings.Người ngoài không vào phòng đèn, không l: Outsiders don’t enter the lamp room or climb the tower at night.
strings.Đứng trên ban công lúc đèn quét là che m: Standing on the gallery while the light sweeps blocks the beam, and it’s easy to slip in the fog.
The boat is booked to return at 2 a.m.
strings.Chúc mừng, mời hai bạn ra sân trạm, đứng: Congratulations, invite you both to the station yard, stand where the beam sweeps overhead, and sit in the station house to wait for the boat
strings.Anh gác đèn không cho lên tháp nhưng chỉ: The keeper won’t let you up the tower but points out the best spot in the yard. She says yes!
strings.Dưới vệt sáng quét qua đầu, cô gái gật đ: Under the beam sweeping overhead, she nods. The two of you sit in the station house with tea, waiting for the boat.
strings.Không lên được đỉnh tháp, mà ảnh sân trạ: You couldn’t reach the top, but the yard photos are even prettier.
strings.Mình giữ đèn, nhưng không phải để làm ng: I keep the light, but not to make people sad.
strings.Cho lên mười phút, mình đứng canh: Let them up for ten minutes, I’ll stand guard
strings.Cho người lạ lên ban công đèn lúc nửa đê: You let a stranger onto the gallery at midnight, and she nearly slips in the fog.
strings.Cô gái trượt chân trên sàn ban công ướt: She slips on the fog-wet gallery floor, luckily the guy catches her in time.
strings.Lỡ có chuyện thì ai chịu?: If something happens, who takes the blame?
I was so scared I wanted to cry, I forgot to take the ring.
strings.Đúng nội quy, nhưng để hai bạn đứng ngoà: By the rules, but you left two people out in the cold at the dock until 2 a.m.
The two of them sit shivering on the stone dock, waiting for a boat.
You could at least have wished us well.
strings.Giữ nội quy bằng tay, nói chuyện bằng lò: Keep the rules with your hands, talk with your heart.
strings.Nội quy giữ đèn và giữ người; từ chối đư: The rules protect the light and the people; you can say no and still be kind.
strings.Ông Sáu Ghe gọi kênh 16: “Cậu quay đèn r: Mr. Sáu Ghe calls on channel 16: “Could you swing the beam northeast for me tonight? The squid are rising!”
strings.Bạn là ông Sáu: cả tháng biển động, tàu: You are Mr. Sáu: a whole month of rough seas, boat stuck at the dock, fuel bill still unpaid.
strings.Đèn Hòn Gió: chớp nhóm 3 trắng, 15 giây,: Hòn Gió Lighthouse: group flashing 3 white, 15 seconds, steady rotation. Ships all over the bay know the light by this characteristic.
His boat has its own squid-fishing lamp rig.
strings.Giải thích đèn quay đều theo danh mục, g: Explain the steady rotation per the list of lights, suggest using the squid lamps, read him tonight's bulletin
strings.Cậu gác đèn không chiều, mà nói có lý, c: The keeper said no, but made sense, and even read me the bulletin.
strings.Ông Sáu bật dàn đèn câu, mực vẫn lên. Gầ: Mr. Sáu turned on his squid lamps and the squid still came up. Near dawn he called to thank you for the bulletin.
I already had squid lamps, forgot all about them.
strings.Đêm đó tôi nhận ra Hòn Gió từ hai mươi h: That night I picked out Hòn Gió from twenty nautical miles away. Thank you.
strings.Dừng mô-tơ, rọi về đông bắc một tiếng: Stop the motor, shine northeast for an hour
strings.Đèn đứng yên một tiếng, tàu hàng gọi đài: The light stood still for an hour, and a cargo ship radioed the coast station asking about a strange light.
A cargo ship mistook the light and drifted off the channel. The coast station called the station again and again.
A wrong light characteristic means ships mistake the light.
That one hour could be a ship.
strings.Tắt bộ đàm, không trả lời: Switch off the radio, don't answer
strings.Không chiều, nhưng gọi mà không trả lời,: Not giving in, but calling and getting no answer upsets the locals.
Mr. Sáu tells the whole dock the station is “acting like a big shot”.
Called and didn't even bother to answer.
You have to keep watch on channel 16, kid.
strings.Đèn biển là của mọi con tàu; từ chối kèm: The lighthouse belongs to every ship; decline with a reason and an alternative.
strings.Pháo hiệu đỏ giữa đêm bão: Red flare in the stormy night
strings.Gió cấp 7. Một pháo hiệu đỏ vọt lên phía: Wind force 7. A red flare shoots up to the southeast. The station dinghy sits right below the dock.
strings.Pháo hiệu đỏ là tín hiệu cấp cứu: có ngư: A red flare is a distress signal: someone's life is in danger.
A small dinghy, only for coastal use in calm seas.
strings.Thấy tín hiệu cấp cứu: báo đài MAYDAY RE: Distress signal seen: call the coast station MAYDAY RELAY, bearing, distance, number of people; keep watching the target.
strings.Báo đài MAYDAY RELAY, đọc phương vị, kho: Call the coast station MAYDAY RELAY, give bearing, distance, number of people, then keep watching the target all night
Hòn Gió Station reported clearly and kept eyes on the target. The rescue ship found the fishing boat within forty minutes.
strings.Tàu cứu nạn theo phương vị của bạn, vớt: The rescue ship followed your bearing and pulled six fishermen out.
strings.Phương vị, khoảng cách, số người: đủ, đà: Bearing, distance, number of people: complete, so the coast station could send a ship right away.
strings.Thấy đèn pha trạm rọi theo, tụi tui biết: Seeing the station's searchlight follow us, we knew someone was watching.
strings.Lấy xuồng của trạm ra cứu cho nhanh: Take the station dinghy out to rescue them faster
strings.Một mình ra khơi bằng xuồng giữa bão, th: Going out alone in a dinghy in a storm makes you the second person who needs rescuing.
strings.Xuồng lật ngay cửa bến. Chú Bảy phải ném: The dinghy capsizes right at the dock mouth. Uncle Bảy has to throw a buoy and haul you in.
strings.Cứu người mà mất thêm người thì cứu ai?: If saving one means losing another, who gets saved?
strings.Đài mất mười phút vì trạm không ai trực: The coast station lost ten minutes because nobody was on the radio.
strings.Chờ xem có pháo hiệu thứ hai cho chắc: Wait for a second flare to be sure
Saw a red flare but waited before reporting.
strings.Mười lăm phút sau mới báo đài. Tàu cứu n: The coast station was called fifteen minutes later. The rescue ship searched a long time before finding them.
Out there, every minute is a life.
strings.Thấy tín hiệu cấp cứu: báo đài ngay, đún: Distress signal seen: call the coast station right away, at the right urgency level, with full info, keep watching the target; never go out alone.
strings.Chú Tư Lực đòi ký đủ hai trăm lít: Uncle Tư Lực wants you to sign for a full two hundred liters
strings.Đo bồn trước và sau khi bơm: chỉ vào 170: Tank measured before and after pumping: only 170 liters went in. Uncle Tư Lực holds out a slip saying 200: “Sign it, kid, I'll make it up next trip.”
strings.Trước bơm 412 lít, sau bơm 582 lít: vào: Before pumping 412 liters, after pumping 582 liters: 170 liters in.
strings.Sổ dầu ghi đúng số đo, người ký chịu trá: The fuel log records the exact measurement; whoever signs is responsible.
strings.Chú Tư Lực từng dọa chở rau héo nếu bị l: Uncle Tư Lực once threatened to bring wilted vegetables if he got a hard time.
strings.Ký đúng 170 lít, ghi chú “giao thiếu 30: Sign for exactly 170 liters, note “short 30 liters”, ask Uncle Tư to co-sign
strings.Cậu gác đèn ký đúng số, có ghi chú rõ rà: The keeper signed the exact number, with a clear note. Nobody has anything to hide.
strings.Chú Tư Lực càu nhàu nhưng ký. Chuyến sau: Uncle Tư Lực grumbled but signed. Next trip he brought the full amount, plus a can of engine oil.
strings.Thằng này cứng. Mà ký đúng thì chú cũng: This kid is stubborn. But with a correct signature, I get fewer questions too.
The fuel log matches the tank liter for liter. Check it and you'll see.
strings.Ký đủ 200 cho êm chuyện: Sign for the full 200 to keep things smooth
Signed for 200 liters but the tank only got 170.
strings.Cuối tháng sổ dầu hụt 30 lít, người ký l: At month-end the fuel log is short 30 liters, and you're the one who signed.
Where did thirty liters go? Explain yourself.
strings.Không ký gì cả, đuổi tàu đi: Sign nothing, send the boat away
strings.Không ký sai, nhưng cũng không có giấy t: Nothing signed wrongly, but no paperwork either, so the station runs short on fuel until the next trip.
strings.Tàu đi, bồn có thêm 170 lít mà không giấ: The boat leaves, the tank gains 170 liters, and no paper records it.
Fine, don't sign, I'll report to the company.
strings.Có giao mà không có phiếu, khó cho cả ha: Delivery without a slip is hard on both sides.
strings.Ký đúng số đo được, ghi rõ phần thiếu; c: Sign the measured amount, note the shortfall clearly; a signature is responsibility.
strings.Nhà văn xin ở lại một tuần: A writer asks to stay a week
strings.Anh Đức có giấy tham quan trong ngày. Ch: Đức has a day-visit permit. It's late afternoon, and he asks: “Just let me stay one week, I need to live it for real.”
strings.Giấy ghi: tham quan, phỏng vấn trong ngà: The permit says: visit and interviews, same day only.
The Biển Ngọc boat still has its 5 p.m. trip.
strings.Không cho ở lại qua đêm, trừ người gặp n: No overnight stays, except for people in distress.
strings.Dẫn anh Đức đi hết trạm, kể chuyện nghề: Show Đức around the whole station, tell stories about the job until afternoon, see him onto the 5 p.m. boat, promise to call and tell more
strings.Cậu gác đèn kể chuyện cả buổi, tiễn tôi: The keeper told stories all afternoon, saw me onto the boat, and even called in the evening to tell more. Enough for a whole book.
strings.Anh Đức về bờ với cả xấp ghi chép. Cuốn: Đức heads back to shore with a thick stack of notes. The book later even has a story about Mun the cat.
strings.Tôi tưởng phải ở mới hiểu. Hóa ra phải n: I thought I had to stay to understand. Turns out I had to listen.
strings.Khách thương thì kể cho đủ, rồi tiễn cho: Treat a guest kindly: tell them plenty, then see them off on time.
strings.Cho ở lại, nhà kho còn chỗ: Let him stay, the storeroom has space
Let an outsider stay on the island against the rules.
strings.Đêm thứ hai anh Đức lên phòng đèn hút th: On the second night Đức goes up to the lamp room to smoke, leaving the gallery door open.
I didn't know fire was banned in the lamp room.
strings.Hết giờ thăm, mời anh xuống tàu ngay: Visiting hours are over, ask him to board the boat now
strings.Đúng giờ, nhưng chưa kể được gì đã mời v: On time, but you sent him off before he heard a single story.
strings.Anh Đức xuống tàu, cuốn sổ ghi chép còn: Đức boards the boat, his notebook still blank.
strings.Tôi đi cả buổi mà chưa nghe được câu chu: I was here all afternoon and haven't heard a single story.
The boat could have waited half an hour.
strings.Giấy cho tham quan trong ngày thì đón ch: For a day-visit permit, host them well and see them off on time; no one stays against the rules.
strings.Đài vừa phát tin áp thấp. Tàu ông Sáu Gh: The coast station just broadcast a low-pressure warning. Mr. Sáu Ghe's boat still starts its engine and leaves the dock, bow pointed out to sea.
strings.Bạn là ông Sáu: cá đang lên, nợ dầu chưa: You are Mr. Sáu: fish are biting, fuel debt unpaid, and the forecast scares people every year anyway.
strings.Áp thấp cách bờ 150 km, gió giật cấp 8,: Low pressure 150 km from shore, gusts force 8, waves 3–4 meters tonight.
strings.Có lệnh cấm tàu thuyền ra khơi từ trưa n: A ban on boats going out to sea has been in force since noon.
strings.Con trai ông Sáu mười sáu tuổi đi theo t: Mr. Sáu's sixteen-year-old son is aboard this trip.
strings.Gọi kênh 16 đọc bản tin, khuyên vào âu t: Call channel 16, read the bulletin, advise him to shelter in the harbor; if he won't listen, report to the Border Guard post by radio
You called me twice, then reported to the border guard. I was mad then, but now I thank you.
strings.Tàu biên phòng chặn ở cửa luồng. Đêm đó: The border guard boat blocked the channel mouth. That night gusts hit force 8, and the whole dock stayed safe.
strings.Tui giận cả tuần. Rồi nghe tin tàu bên H: I was mad for a week. Then I heard the boat from Hòn Đỏ went missing, and I wasn't mad anymore.
I'm so scared but I don't dare tell Dad.
strings.Ông Sáu đi biển bốn chục năm, ông tự biế: Mr. Sáu has fished for forty years, he knows what he's doing
strings.Thấy tàu ra khơi lúc có lệnh cấm mà khôn: Saw a boat go out during a ban without calling or reporting.
strings.Nửa đêm tàu ông Sáu chết máy giữa sóng,: At midnight Mr. Sáu's boat breaks down in the waves, and the coast station has to send a rescue ship.
strings.Trạm thấy mà không báo, đài biết thì đã: The station saw it and didn't report; by the time the coast station knew, it was too late.
I stood at the dock all night.
strings.Gọi năn nỉ ông về, ông không nghe thì th: Call and beg him to turn back; if he won't listen, so be it
strings.Có gọi, nhưng không báo biên phòng khi t: You called, but didn't report to the Border Guard while the boat kept going.
strings.Tàu ông Sáu ra tới hòn Đá Bia thì sóng đ: Mr. Sáu's boat reached Đá Bia islet when waves smashed the cabin, and he had to turn back in the night.
strings.Cậu gọi mà tui không nghe. Lẽ ra cậu phả: You called and I didn't listen. You should have reported right away.
strings.Cảnh báo không xong thì báo người có quy: If warning fails, tell someone with the power to stop him.
strings.Cảnh báo sớm và rõ; không ngăn được thì: Warn early and clearly; if you can't stop them, report to the authorities, don't let a boat sail into a storm.
strings.Trung tâm huấn luyện Xí nghiệp Bảo đảm h: Vịnh Ngọc Maritime Safety Company Training Center (simulated class)
strings.Giữ đèn đúng giờ, đúng đặc tính; quan tr: Keep the light on time and with the right characteristic; observe the weather and call the coast station; report distress at the right level and position; keep the station rules. The game's simple rules.
strings.Thắp đèn trước giờ mặt trời lặn 15 phút,: Light up 15 minutes before sunset, switch off 15 minutes after sunrise (the game's station rules). Switching off early while it's still dark is dangerous.
strings.Thắp xong thì bấm giờ đếm chớp, so với d: After lighting up, time the flashes and compare with the list of lights. Wrong light characteristic or broken fog horn: call the coast station right away so it can broadcast a maritime notice.
strings.Lau kính đèn thì tắt mô-tơ, treo biển cấ: To clean the lamp glass, switch off the motor and hang the do-not-start sign first. Never clean while the lamp pedestal is rotating.
strings.Sổ trực, sổ dầu ghi đúng số đo, đúng sự: Logbook and fuel log must be accurate and truthful. When signing for fuel, measure the tank before and after pumping and sign for the exact liters that went in.
strings.Quan trắc: đọc máy đo gió, nhìn mặt biển: Weather observation: read the anemometer, look at the sea surface, far landmarks, barometer; report all four readings. Wind force 6 or fast-dropping pressure means issuing a warning to boats.
strings.Thấy người gặp nạn: báo đài đúng mức (MA: See someone in distress: call the coast station at the right level (MAYDAY RELAY when life is threatened, PAN-PAN when help is needed but not in danger), give bearing, distance, number of people, then keep watching the target.
strings.Người dưới nước gần bờ: ném phao có dây,: Someone in the water near shore: throw a lifebuoy with a line, don't jump in. Never take a dinghy out to sea alone in rough weather.
strings.Khách ra đảo: xem giấy của xí nghiệp, ch: Island visitors: check the company permit, daytime only, escorted, nobody enters the lamp room, nobody stays overnight. People in distress always get temporary shelter and a call to the coast station.
strings.Mặt trời lặn lúc 17:45. Thắp đèn lúc nào: Sunset is at 17:45. When do you light up?
strings.Đêm bão thấy pháo hiệu đỏ, xuồng của trạ: Stormy night, red flare spotted, the station dinghy is at the dock.
strings.Lấy xuồng ra cứu: Take the dinghy out to rescue
strings.Báo đài MAYDAY RELAY, đủ vị trí, canh gi: Call the coast station MAYDAY RELAY, full position, keep watching the target
strings.Báo đài đúng mức và canh giữ; không tự r: Call the coast station at the right level and keep watching; never go out alone.
strings.Hai bạn chèo kayak ướt sũng, không giấy: Two kayakers, soaking wet with no papers, ask for shelter after dark.
strings.Từ chối vì không có giấy: Refuse because they have no papers
strings.Cho trú tạm, báo đài: Give temporary shelter, call the coast station
strings.Cho ở lại, khỏi báo ai: Let them stay, tell no one
strings.Người gặp nạn luôn được trú, và đài phải: People in distress always get shelter, and the coast station must know.
strings.Tàu tiếp tế bơm vào 170 lít, phiếu ghi 2: The supply boat pumped in 170 liters, the slip says 200.
strings.Mặt trời mọc lúc 05:40. Tắt đèn lúc nào?: Sunrise is at 05:40. When do you switch off?
strings.Danh mục đèn ghi chớp nhóm 3, chu kỳ 15: The list of lights says group flashing 3, 15-second cycle. You count 19 seconds.
strings.Báo đài ngay: Call the coast station right away
strings.Đèn sai đặc tính thì tàu có thể nhận nhầ: A wrong light characteristic means ships may mistake the light.
strings.Lau kính đèn buổi sáng. Việc đầu tiên?: Cleaning the lamp glass in the morning. First thing to do?
strings.Tắt mô-tơ, treo biển cấm bật: Switch off the motor, hang the do-not-start sign
A rotating lamp pedestal can pinch hands and catch sleeves.
strings.Máy đo gió chỉ 12 m/s. Cấp gió?: The anemometer reads 12 m/s. Wind force?
strings.Áp kế tụt 4 hPa trong ba giờ, gió mới cấ: Barometer dropped 4 hPa in three hours, wind only force 4 so far.
strings.Báo đài, phát cảnh báo: Call the coast station, issue a warning
strings.Chờ gió lên rồi báo: Wait for the wind to pick up, then report
A fast pressure drop warns of a low-pressure system.
strings.Tàu cá chết máy trôi dạt, không nghiêng,: A fishing boat's engine died and it's drifting, not tilting, no water coming in.
Needs help but life isn't in danger yet.
strings.Người chới với dưới nước cách bến ba chụ: Someone is flailing in the water thirty meters from the dock.
strings.Ném phao có dây, báo đài, mắt không rời: Throw a lifebuoy with a line, call the coast station, never take your eyes off them
strings.Chạy đi tìm người giúp: Run to find someone to help
Throw the lifebuoy, don't jump in.
strings.Có lệnh cấm ra khơi, một tàu cá vẫn rời: A ban on going out to sea is in force, a fishing boat still leaves the dock, and won't answer calls.
strings.Kệ, họ tự biết: Leave them, they know what they're doing
strings.Không ngăn được thì báo người có thẩm qu: If you can't stop them, report to the authorities.
strings.Cặp đôi không giấy tờ xin lên ban công đ: A couple with no papers asks to go up to the lamp gallery at midnight to propose.
strings.Cho lên mười phút: Let them up for ten minutes
strings.Chúc mừng, mời ra sân trạm, không cho lê: Congratulate them, invite them to the station yard, no going up the tower
strings.Đóng cửa không nói gì: Close the door without a word
strings.Không ai vào phòng đèn trái nội quy; từ: Nobody enters the lamp room against the rules; decline but stay kind.
strings.Nhóm làm phim xin tắt đèn mười phút “cho: A film crew asks you to switch off the light for ten minutes “for the atmosphere”.
strings.Tắt mười phút thôi: Switch off for just ten minutes
strings.Không tắt, gợi ý quay đèn quét trong sươ: Don't switch off, suggest sweeping the beam through the fog
strings.Tắt nếu không có tàu: Switch off if no ships are around
A lighthouse must never go dark.
strings.Người lạ trả tiền xin gửi mấy thùng hàng: A stranger pays to store a few sealed crates in the station storeroom.
strings.Nhận tiền, cho gửi: Take the money, let them store it
strings.Từ chối, báo biên phòng qua đài: Refuse, report to the Border Guard by radio
strings.Cho gửi, không nhận tiền: Let them store it, take no money

strings.Mỗi ngày được lái xe đi chơi một chuyến:: Take one ride a day: to the sea, to watch the sunset, a flight over the street. Spirits go up for a little fuel money.
strings.Khung thép, giỏ mây đằng trước, chuông k: Steel frame, a wicker basket up front, a bell that goes ding-ding. Fits a bunch of flowers.
strings.Sạc một đêm chạy cả ngày, lên dốc cầu nh: Charge it overnight, ride all day; bridge slopes feel like nothing.
strings.Bền như trâu, đổ xăng một lần chạy cả tu: Tough as an ox, one tank lasts a week. Everyone in the alley knows how to fix it.
strings.Dáng tròn, yên da nâu, cốp rộng để vừa á: Round body, brown leather seat, a trunk that fits a raincoat and a lunch box.
strings.Nhỏ gọn, len hẻm xe hơi dễ dàng, máy lạn: Small and nimble in car alleys, with cool air-con on sunny days.
strings.Gầm cao, cốp rộng, đủ chỗ chở cả nhà về: High clearance, a big trunk, room to take the whole family home for the holidays.
strings.Sơn bóng loáng, vô lăng gỗ, mở mui ra là: Glossy paint, a wooden wheel; drop the top and the whole street turns to look.
strings.Hai cánh buồm trắng, cabin nhỏ đủ pha ấm: Two white sails and a little cabin just big enough to brew tea. Moored at the pier past the dike.
strings.Boong gỗ rộng, phòng ngủ dưới khoang, sâ: A wide wooden deck, a cabin below, a sun deck for sunsets over the bay.
strings.Hai chỗ ngồi, cánh cao, cất cánh từ đườn: Two seats, high wings, takes off from the grass strip at the private airfield.
Eight leather seats, as smooth as your living room. Fly to the island for seafood on the weekend and back.
strings.Gió bờ kênh mát rượi, bạn ghé mua ly nướ: A cool breeze along the canal; you stop for a sugarcane juice and drift home.
strings.Một vòng quanh chợ, cô bán hoa dúi cho c: A loop around the market; the flower lady tucks a sprig of daisies into your basket.
strings.Đường chiều vắng, đèn phố vừa lên. Đầu ó: Quiet evening streets, the lamps just coming on. Your head feels light.
strings.Mở cửa kính, bật bài hát quen, chạy dọc: Windows down, a favourite song on, you drive along the river until the sun is gone.
strings.Bà Tám đi nhờ ra chợ đầu mối, khen xe êm: Grandma Tám catches a ride to the wholesale market and says the car is ever so smooth.
strings.Ghé quán bánh xèo ngoại ô, ăn xong lái v: You stop at a bánh xèo place out of town and drive home slowly after.
strings.Neo ngoài vịnh, mặt trời lặn đỏ rực sau: Anchored in the bay, the sun sets red behind the hills. The salty breeze feels lovely.
strings.Bầy cá chuồn nhảy quanh mũi thuyền. Bạn: Flying fish leap around the bow. You cast a line and don't care if anything bites.
strings.Ngồi trên boong pha ấm trà, nghe sóng vỗ: You brew tea on deck and listen to the waves lapping.
strings.Từ trên cao, cả khu phố nhỏ như mô hình:: From up high the whole neighbourhood looks like a model: you can even spot Grandma Tám's roof.
strings.Bay qua dòng sông lúc hoàng hôn, mây hồn: You fly over the river at sunset, pink clouds stretching to the horizon.
strings.Hạ cánh xuống đảo, ăn đĩa ghẹ hấp rồi ba: You land on the island, eat a plate of steamed crab and fly back in time for dinner.

strings.Chiếc “đang đi” hiện trên hồ sơ, trước n: The one you're “riding” shows on your profile, outside your home and on Job Street.
strings.Không có phí giữ xe hay bảo dưỡng tự trừ: No parking or upkeep fees ever come off by themselves. Fuel is paid only when you go out.
strings.✅ Hồ sơ không sai bước nào được 32 xu. M: ✅ A dossier with no wrong step pays 32 xu. Each mistake takes a little off; on probation it takes less.
strings.Tính là sai lý do. Mỗi lần trừ 5 xu thưở: Counts as a wrong reason. Each one takes 5 xu off the tray bonus (2 xu on probation), never below 14 xu.
strings.Bớt 8 xu thưởng hồ sơ (thử việc 4 xu) và: 8 xu off the dossier bonus (4 xu on probation) and −3 trust. Work left unfinished at day end costs 2 trust each, up to 6.
strings.⏰ Chuyển lương trước hạn. Hồ sơ không sa: ⏰ Send the payroll before the deadline. A dossier with no wrong step gets the full bonus; each mistake costs 4 xu (2 xu on probation).
strings.Bớt 8 xu thưởng (thử việc 4 xu), mất 3 t: 8 xu off the bonus (4 xu on probation), −3 trust; a late payroll costs 2 more. Late returns: 3 xu a day; on day 5 the boss files it for you, −3 trust.
strings.⏰ Nộp trước hạn: +2 tin tưởng, tin tưởng: ⏰ Hand in before the deadline: +2 trust; at 75 trust or more, +5 xu. No wrong step pays 32 xu.
strings.Mất 20 phút (thử việc 13 phút), mất 1 ti: Costs 20 minutes (13 on probation) and 1 trust; the matching-board bonus loses 4 xu per mistake (2 xu on probation).
strings.Mất thêm 15 phút (thử việc 8 phút), thưở: Costs 15 more minutes (8 on probation) and the bonus shrinks. Even with many mistakes you still get 14 xu.
strings.Thuế & kế toán: mỗi hồ sơ thưởng thêm 2: Tax & accounting: every dossier pays 2 xu more, and even with many mistakes you get at least 14 xu (was 10).
strings.Đang thử việc nghề văn phòng: sai một bư: On probation in an office job: a wrong step costs only 2 xu, you always keep half the bonus, lateness costs less, fixing mistakes takes less time.
strings.Mỗi lần ghép sai tốn thêm thời gian soát: Each wrong match costs extra time to recheck (less while on probation).

strings.🧭 Mở [[Hành trình]]: “Việc cần làm” của: 🧭 Open [[Journey]]: the chapter's “To-do” tells you what to do, and the big button right below takes you to the right place.

strings.✨ Việc đầu tiên ở mỗi nơi, chỗ cần bấm s: ✨ On your first task at each place, the spot to tap lights up. Just follow the “Next step” line.

strings.Đổi nghề, quay lại chỗ làm cũ thế nào?: How do I switch jobs or go back to an old workplace?
strings.🧭 Mở [[Hành trình]], kéo xuống “Nơi làm: 🧭 Open [[Journey]], scroll down to “Workplace”, then tap [[Continue]] or [[Start]] on the place you want.
strings.🔁 Game mở lại đúng nơi bạn làm lần trước: 🔁 The game reopens the place you worked last time, which is why it feels like “always the same place”. You can switch any time.
strings.⚠️ Làm xong việc đang dở hoặc bấm [[Khép: ⚠️ Finish the task in progress or tap [[Close today's shift]] before you go, so you aren't fined for leaving work unfinished.
strings.Nghỉ việc thế nào?: How do I quit a job?
strings.💼 Chỉ nơi làm thuê (giáo viên, nhà thuốc: 💼 Only employed jobs (teacher, pharmacy, office…) need you to resign. Tap [[Close today's shift]] first.
strings.📋 Rồi mở [[Việc làm]] trong menu, ở Hồ s: 📋 Then open [[Tasks]] in the menu, and in the Job file tap [[Quit the job]]. To work there again, just apply again.
strings.🏪 Tiệm của bạn thì cứ sang nơi khác. Muố: 🏪 For your own shop, just go somewhere else. To skip the upkeep cost: [[Your money]] → [[Invest, pause]] → [[Pause]].
strings.Mở thêm nghề mới thế nào?: How do I unlock new jobs?
strings.📚 Nơi làm mới mở theo chương. Làm đủ các: 📚 New workplaces open by chapter. Finish every “To-do” item of the chapter in [[Journey]] to unlock more.
strings.🔒 Ô “Sắp mở” ở cuối “Nơi làm việc” là cá: 🔒 The “Opening soon” tiles at the end of “Workplace” are the next chapter's places. Employed jobs and offices open later.
strings.Làm nghề gì có nhiều tiền?: Which jobs make the most money?
strings.🏪 Tiệm của bạn: tiền lời vào quỹ tiệm. L: 🏪 Your own shop: profit goes into the shop fund. Do it right, earn 5★ and order just enough stock to sell, and you'll profit a lot.
strings.💼 Làm thuê: lương cố định mỗi ngày. Nơi: 💼 Employed: a fixed wage every day. Places that open later pay more, like pilot 65–110 coins or Group Accountant 50–120 coins.
strings.👛 Tiền lời nằm trong quỹ tiệm, nhớ rút v: 👛 Profit stays in the shop fund, so remember to withdraw it to your wallet to spend it.
strings.👛 Chạm ô tiền ở góc trên để mở [[Tiền củ: 👛 Tap the money chip at the top to open [[Your money]]. Money in a shop fund: tap [[Withdraw to your wallet]] at the place you want to withdraw from.
strings.🏦 Tiền trong ngân hàng: mở [[Ngân hàng]]: 🏦 Money in the bank: open [[Bank]], type the amount in coins, then tap [[Withdraw]]. Street Bank ATMs charge no fee.
strings.🔒 Quỹ tiệm luôn giữ lại 80 xu và tiền hó: 🔒 The shop fund always keeps 80 coins plus money for unpaid bills, so you can't withdraw all of it.
strings.Làm giáo viên (làm thuê) sao chưa có lươ: I work as a teacher (employed), so why haven't I been paid?
strings.📝 Phải được nhận việc trước: [[Xin việc]: 📝 You have to be hired first: [[Apply]], pass the interview, then sign the contract.
strings.💵 Lương trả khi bấm [[Khép ca hôm nay]],: 💵 Pay comes when you tap [[Close today's shift]], if you finished at least 1 task that day (teacher: teach 1 full lesson). Probation pays 85%.
👛 Pay goes straight to your wallet, not the shop fund. Look for the “Daily pay …” line in the wallet log.
strings.No bụng, tỉnh táo thấp quá thì làm sao?: What do I do when Fullness or Alert is too low?
strings.🍱 Buổi trưa (11:30–13:30 giờ tiệm) thẻ v: 🍱 At lunchtime (11:30–13:30 shop time) the task card asks “Lunchtime! What'll it be?”: pick a dish.
strings.🍢 Đói hay buồn ngủ giữa ca: chọn món ở “: 🍢 Hungry or sleepy mid-shift: pick something from “Extra food” on the task card or in Everyday, paid from your wallet. ☕ Coffee keeps you Alert.
strings.🌙 Tối khép ca, chọn bữa tối và ngủ sớm:: 🌙 When you close the day, choose a dinner and go to bed early: sleep at 22:00 and you'll have 100 Alert the next morning.
strings.Kho ở đâu, nhập hàng thế nào?: Where's the stock, and how do I restock?
strings.📦 Tiệm bán hàng nào cũng có kho riêng. C: 📦 Every shop that sells goods has its own stock. How to open it at your current workplace is in the job guide, under Restock.
strings.🛒 Chọn món, số lượng và nhà cung cấp rồi: 🛒 Pick the item, quantity and supplier, then tap [[Place order]]. When the goods arrive, open the crate, count it, then put it on the shelf.
strings.💼 Nơi làm thuê (lớp học, văn phòng…) khô: 💼 Employed workplaces (classroom, office…) have no stock.
strings.Xem cách nhập hàng ở nơi đang làm: See how to restock at your current workplace
strings.Đi dự đám cưới thế nào?: How do I go to a wedding?
strings.💍 Mở menu [[Khu phố]] → [[Lịch cưới]]. T: 💍 Open the [[Neighborhood]] menu → [[Wedding calendar]]. The party opens 5 minutes early and lasts 10 minutes: tap [[Attend]].
strings.🪙 Có tài khoản thì mỗi phút ở lại được 2: 🪙 With an account, you get 20 coins for every minute you stay (up to 2 weddings a day). Without an account, you can only watch.
strings.💌 Bạn bè cưới sẽ mời bạn và nhắc trước g: 💌 Friends who get married will invite you and remind you before the party.
strings.Mừng cưới bao nhiêu?: How much should I give as a wedding gift?
strings.🧧 Tùy lòng, không bắt buộc. Trong tiệc b: 🧧 It's up to you, not required. At the party tap 🧧, choose 10, 20, 50, 100 or 200 coins and a wish, then [[Send envelope]].
strings.👛 Tiền lấy từ ví, chia đôi cho cô dâu ch: 👛 The money comes from your wallet and is split between the bride and groom. Up to 500 coins per wedding. Requires an account.

strings.Bác Lâm mang từ Nam Định lên, ba mươi nă: Uncle Lâm brought it up from Nam Định, thirty years of ladling broth. Pick it up and you know: one scoop fills one bowl.

strings.Bếp than đỏ lửa, nồi nóng lên từ từ. Khó: The charcoal glows red, the pot warms up slowly. Coal smoke drifts out into the alley.

strings.Bé làm đổ bát nước dùng: A kid spills a bowl of broth
strings.Một bé ngồi bàn ngoài với tay lấy đũa, b: A kid at the outside table reaches for chopsticks and a bowl of hot broth spills on the back of the hand. The kid screams.
strings.Xả nước mát lên chỗ bỏng mười lăm phút,: Run cool water over the burn for fifteen minutes, put nothing strange on it
strings.Bàn tay bé đỡ đỏ dần. Mẹ bé cảm ơn, hẹn: The kid's hand slowly gets less red. Mom thanks you and says she'll take the kid to the health station to be safe.

strings.Con tôi bị bỏng mà quán bôi kem đánh răn: My child got burned and the shop put toothpaste on it, the doctor had to wash it all off.
strings.Bé vẫn rát. Ra trạm y tế, bác sĩ phải rử: It still stings. At the health station, the doctor has to wash off the layer of toothpaste.

strings.Kệ, mèo chưa ăn đâu: Never mind, the cat won't eat it

strings.Một khách chụp được cảnh con mèo đứng cạ: A customer snaps a photo of the cat next to the basket of meat.
strings.Một người chở thùng xốp ghé: “Thịt bò rẻ: A man with a foam box pulls up: “Beef at half the market price, no paperwork hassle. Want ten kilos?”

strings.Lấy năm ký cho rẻ: Take five kilos to save money

strings.Chiều đó có khách gọi điện, kêu ăn xong: That afternoon a customer called, complaining of a stomachache after eating.
strings.Khách xin thêm nước dùng: A customer asks for more broth
strings.Anh Sáu húp hết nước, chìa tô ra: “Cho a: Sáu slurps up all his broth and holds out the bowl: “Mind giving me a bit more broth, it's so good!”
strings.Chan thêm một muôi nóng, không lấy tiền: Ladle one more hot scoop, free of charge
strings.Anh Sáu cười khà khà: “Ngoài này chơi đẹ: Sáu chuckles: “You folks here play fair!”
strings.Thêm nước thì tính thêm hai xu: Charge two extra coins for more broth
Sáu pays, a little let down.

Sáu looks at the pot brimming full and shakes his head.
strings.Hai cán bộ phường ghé: “Quán cho xem giấ: Two ward officials stop by: “Show us the meat sourcing papers, the dishwashing area and the trash bin, please.”
strings.Đưa sổ nhập thịt có giấy kiểm dịch, dẫn: Show the meat purchase book with quarantine papers, lead them to the dishwashing area
strings.Cán bộ ghi “đạt”, còn dặn đậy nắp thùng: The officials mark “pass” and remind you to cover the trash bin tightly.
strings.Xin hẹn hôm khác, đang đông khách: Ask to reschedule, the shop is packed
strings.Đoàn hẹn tuần sau quay lại, ghi tên quán: The team says they'll be back next week and notes the shop's name in their book.
strings.Mời hai anh tô phở cho qua: Offer the two of them a bowl of phở to get by
strings.Thấy quán mời cán bộ ăn phở cho qua kiểm: The shop offered the officials phở to get through the inspection, what do you make of that?
The two officials decline and write a more detailed report.
strings.Khách bỏ quên điện thoại: A customer leaves a phone behind
strings.Dọn bàn thì thấy chiếc điện thoại nằm dư: Clearing the table, you find a phone under a paper napkin. It looks like Linh's, who just bought takeaway.
strings.Cất vào ngăn kéo, chờ chủ quay lại hoặc: Put it in the drawer, wait for the owner to return or call a relative's number
strings.Mười phút sau cô Linh hớt hải quay lại,: Ten minutes later Linh rushes back, nearly in tears of relief.
strings.Để nguyên trên bàn: Leave it right there on the table
strings.Lát sau chiếc điện thoại vẫn nằm đó, may: A while later the phone is still there, luckily nobody took it.
strings.Đăng lên nhóm phố tìm chủ, chụp cả màn h: Post in the neighborhood group to find the owner, with a photo of the lock screen
strings.Quán tốt bụng nhưng đăng cả ảnh màn hình: The shop meant well but posted a photo of my lock screen with my messages online.
strings.Cô Linh tìm lại được máy, nhưng hơi ngại: Linh gets her phone back, but feels a bit embarrassed that her messages were exposed in the photo.
strings.Mưa hắt vào bàn ngoài: Rain blows onto the outside tables
strings.Mưa xiên hắt vào mấy bàn ngoài, ống đũa: Slanting rain blows onto the outside tables, the chopstick holder and the basket of quẩy are soaked.
strings.Kéo bạt, dời bàn vào trong, thay ống đũa: Pull the tarp, move the tables inside, swap in a dry chopstick holder
Customers sit dry, the quẩy stays crisp.
strings.Để tạnh mưa rồi dọn: Wait for the rain to stop, then tidy up

strings.Tô phở nhiều mì chính: A bowl with too much MSG
strings.Ông giáo Thụ đặt đũa xuống: “Ông dặn khô: Teacher Thụ sets down his chopsticks: “I said no MSG, so why does my throat feel so dry after this, kid?”
strings.Bạn là ông giáo Thụ, ăn phở ở đây mười n: You are Teacher Thụ, who has eaten phở here for ten years, and MSG leaves your throat dry and your head aching.
strings.Muôi vừa chan là muôi múc ở nồi lớn, nồi: The ladle just used came from the big pot, which has had MSG in it since morning.
strings.Bác Lâm nấu riêng một nồi nhỏ không mì c: Uncle Lâm cooks a separate small pot with no MSG for regulars who ask.
strings.Lúc gọi món ông đã dặn rõ: không mì chín: When ordering he had said clearly: no MSG.
strings.Xin lỗi ông, làm tô khác bằng nước nồi n: Sorry, sir, I'll make another bowl from the small pot, no charge for the bad bowl
strings.Quán lỡ tay nhưng nhận ngay, làm lại tô: The shop slipped up but owned it right away and remade the bowl from the separate pot. Worthy of a regular's loyalty.
strings.Ông giáo húp thìa nước mới, gật gù: “Thế: The teacher sips the fresh broth and nods: “Now that's phở.”
A slip can be fixed, he doesn't hold it against you.
strings.Khách dặn gì phải nhớ cái muôi múc ở nồi: Remember which pot the ladle comes from for each request.
strings.Rót cho ông cốc trà đá cho đỡ khô cổ: Pour him a glass of iced tea to ease his dry throat
strings.Quán có hỏi han, nhưng tô phở vẫn là tô: The shop asked after him, but the bowl is still a bowl with MSG.
strings.Ông giáo uống trà, ăn nốt nửa tô rồi về: The teacher drinks his tea, finishes half the bowl and leaves early.
strings.Trà đá không làm tô phở hết mì chính đượ: Iced tea can't take the MSG out of a bowl of phở.
He's told you for years now.
strings.Dặn rõ ràng mà còn chối. Mười năm ăn ở đ: He said it plainly and still got denied. Ten years of eating here, sad.
strings.Ông giáo gấp tờ báo, đứng dậy về, sáng h: The teacher folds his newspaper and gets up to leave; the next morning he doesn't show up.
He can taste it right away, kid.
Lost a regular over one ladle of broth.
strings.Khách dặn không mì chính thì múc nồi nhỏ: When a customer says no MSG, use the small pot. If you slip, own it and remake the bowl.
strings.Mối thịt quen báo tăng giá. Một người kh: The regular meat supplier announces a price hike. Another man messages offering beef thirty percent cheaper, “no paperwork, delivered to your door”.
strings.Thịt mẫu màu đỏ sẫm, ấn tay vào lõm mãi: The sample meat is dark red, a dent from a finger press never springs back, and the surface is slimy.
strings.Người bán không có giấy kiểm dịch, không: The seller has no quarantine papers and won't say which slaughterhouse it came from.
strings.Mối quen có tem kiểm dịch từng lô, tăng: The regular supplier has a quarantine stamp on every batch, and the price is up because live cattle got pricier.
strings.Giữ mối quen, xin bớt chút, tăng giá tô: Keep the regular supplier, ask for a small discount, raise the phở price by one coin and tell customers plainly
strings.Quán tăng một xu nhưng nói rõ lý do, thị: The shop raised the price by one coin but explained why, and the meat is still fresh and tasty. Fair enough.
strings.Khách quen gật gù, thịt vẫn đỏ tươi, ăn: Regulars nod, the meat is still bright red, they eat with peace of mind.
If one coin buys peace of mind, I'll pay.
strings.Ba mươi năm bán phở chưa lần nào mua thị: Thirty years selling phở and never once bought meat of unknown origin.
strings.Mua một nửa thịt rẻ để bù lỗ: Buy half cheap meat to cover the loss
strings.Tô hôm nay thịt dai, mùi lạ. Quán đổi mố: The meat in today's bowl is tough with a strange smell. Did the shop change suppliers?
Customers leave meat uneaten, and some ask outright.
This isn't the same meat as usual.
Saving money that way just loses customers.
strings.Đổi hẳn sang mối rẻ: Switch entirely to the cheap supplier
strings.Ăn xong cả nhà đau bụng. Không dám quay: The whole family got stomachaches after eating. We won't be back.
strings.Tối đó có ba khách gọi điện kêu đau bụng: That night three customers called about stomachaches.
Her kid threw up all night.
strings.Thịt không nguồn gốc là vi phạm an toàn: Meat with no known source violates food safety rules.
Meat must have a traceable source and quarantine papers. If the price goes up, be honest with customers, and don't switch to meat of unknown origin.
strings.Anh Sáu bưng tô phở trở lại quầy: “Phở g: Sáu carries his bowl back to the counter: “What kind of phở is stone cold, the rare beef is still bright red, kid!”
strings.Lúc nãy châm nước với xương mới, nồi tụt: Just now you topped up with water and new bones, and the pot dropped to eighty-some degrees and hasn't come back to a boil.
strings.Miếng tái còn đỏ, nước không đủ nóng để: The rare beef is still red, the broth isn't hot enough to cook it just right.
strings.Nồi chưa lăn tăn thì chưa chan, khách ch: If the pot isn't at a simmer, don't ladle. Making a customer wait one more minute beats serving a cold bowl.
strings.Xin lỗi, chờ nồi sôi lại rồi làm tô mới: Sorry, wait for the pot to boil again and I'll make a fresh hot bowl
strings.Tô đầu nguội thật nhưng quán đổi tô mới: The first bowl really was cold, but the shop swapped in a fresh piping hot bowl with pink rare beef. Good.
Sáu slurps down the new bowl and gives a thumbs up.
Swapping it right away is all I ask, kid.
After refilling the pot, wait for it to come back to a boil.
strings.Chan thêm muôi nước nóng vào tô cũ: Ladle another scoop of hot broth into the old bowl
strings.Có chan thêm nước nóng, nhưng tái vẫn tá: Hot broth was added, but the rare beef is still half raw and the noodles are bloated.
Sáu eats it anyway, the noodles already swollen.
A bowl of phở has to be hot from the start.
strings.“Phở mùa này nguội nhanh lắm anh”: “Phở cools down fast this season, sir”
strings.Bưng ra tô nguội tái sống, còn nói trời: Served a cold bowl with raw-ish beef and blamed the weather. Forget it.
strings.Anh Sáu đặt tiền lên bàn rồi đi, tô còn: Sáu puts money on the table and leaves, the bowl untouched.
Next time he'll go to another shop.

strings.Châm nước, thêm xương xong phải chờ nồi: After adding water and bones, wait until the pot is back to a gentle simmer before ladling. If a bowl is cold, make a fresh one.
strings.Gió mùa: nồi mất nhiệt nhanh, giữ lửa ch: Monsoon wind: the pot loses heat fast, keep the flame steady.
Early market: customers arrive from five thirty.
Morning rain: pull the tarp over the outside tables.

strings.Mở quán phở đầu ngày: Opening the phở shop for the day
strings.Bác Lâm dặn: “Nồi xương bác ủ lửa từ đêm: Uncle Lâm says: “I kept the bone pot on low heat all night. Set a gentle simmer, skim the foam, taste the broth, and smell yesterday's noodles before you sell.”
strings.Vào bếp thôi! Nồi nước dùng đang bốc khó: Time to get in the kitchen! The broth pot is steaming under the banyan tree.
strings.Có chuyện ở quán, quyết xong rồi bán tiế: Something's come up at the shop, settle it and then carry on selling.

strings.Lửa lăn tăn giữ 97 °C: tái chín hồng, nư: A gentle simmer at 97 °C: rare beef cooks pink, broth stays clear. High heat is fast but foams, and a long boil leaves the broth cloudy all day. Low heat isn't hot enough to cook the rare beef.

strings.Vòng qua đám mây giông rồi trở về hướng: Fly around the storm cloud, then return to your original heading.
strings.Dùng ← → hoặc kéo cần lái sang bên để ng: Use ← → or move the yoke sideways to bank; center it after avoiding the storm.
strings.Đừng bay xuyên mây giông. Chỉnh từng chú: Avoid flying through the storm. Make small corrections and check your route afterward.
strings.Lần này không còn đủ dầu bay lại. Chỉnh: There is not enough fuel for another go-around. Make gentle corrections using the magenta guide and captain’s instructions.
strings.Giảm ga bằng S hoặc kéo cần ga xuống. Ch: Reduce throttle with S or the slider. If unstable at the checkpoint, press G to go around.
strings.Tăng ga bằng W hoặc đẩy cần ga lên. Chưa: Increase throttle with W or the slider. If unstable, press G to go around.
strings.Hạ mũi nhẹ bằng ↑, giữ tốc độ. Nếu chưa: Lower the nose gently with ↑ while maintaining speed. If unstable, press G to go around.
strings.Kéo mũi lên nhẹ bằng ↓. Nếu chưa ổn định: Raise the nose gently with ↓. If unstable, press G to go around.
strings.Không thấy đường băng hoặc chưa ổn định:: Runway not visible or approach unstable? Press G to go around safely.
Reduce throttle and gently hold the nose up for touchdown.
strings.Giữ 115 knot, 2 đèn trắng + 2 đỏ và tim: Hold 115 knots, two white and two red lights, and the runway centerline.
strings.Kéo ga xuống hết; kéo cần lái nhẹ về mìn: Idle the throttle; gently pull the yoke toward you (↓), without sudden movements.
strings.Ga chỉnh tốc độ, mũi chỉnh độ cao; bám t: Use throttle for speed and pitch for altitude; follow the magenta guide. Check at 1,000 ft and 200 ft.
strings.Đọc tình huống và chọn cách xử lý trước: Read the situation and choose a response before continuing.
strings.Chọn phương án ở bảng tình huống. Máy ba: Choose an option in the situation panel. The autopilot is flying.
strings.Đối chiếu thời tiết, sức khỏe khách và l: Consider the weather, passenger health and fuel; read the outcome before continuing.
strings.Chờ cơ trưởng đưa tàu về vị trí tiếp cận: Wait for the captain to return the aircraft to a new approach.
strings.Thả cần lái; hệ thống đang điều khiển đo: Release the yoke; the system is handling the go-around.
strings.Khi nhận lại lái, giảm thao tác mạnh và: When taking control again, use gentle inputs and hold the target speed.
strings.Chờ lăn vào bến, rồi đỗ tàu để khép chuy: Wait for taxi-in, then park the aircraft to complete the flight.
strings.Lái tự động đang đưa tàu tới bước tiếp t: The autopilot is taking you to the next stage.
Release the yoke and follow the captain’s instructions.
strings.Bạn có thể mở Học từng bước bất kỳ lúc n: Open Step-by-step lessons at any time to review the instructions.
strings.Tan ca hiện tại, rồi chọn Mở ca quản lý: Finish this shift, then choose Start management shift to assign crew tasks.
strings.Chọn Thăng tiến → Mở ca quản lý để giao: Choose Promotions → Start management shift to assign crew tasks.
strings.Từ bậc 3 · Cơ trưởng huấn luyện, mở Ca q: Management shifts unlock at rank 3 · Training Captain. Complete good flight days and pass promotion reviews.
strings.Dừng chờ không mất xu. Qua vạch khi đèn: Waiting is free. Crossing on red costs 12 coins; the first second after red begins is exempt to allow a safe stop.
strings.🔴 Vừa chuyển đỏ · dừng trước vạch: 🔴 Just turned red · stop before the line
strings.Mua sắm bằng tiền trong ngân hàng được k: Can I shop using money in my bank account?
strings.Khi xác nhận mua sắm cá nhân, chọn Tiền: When confirming a personal purchase, choose Salary / wallet, bank account, card or joint funds if supported. Received salary is in your wallet; unpaid salary cannot be spent yet.
strings.Chọn tài khoản là chuyển khoản trực tiếp: Choosing an account pays by direct transfer; insufficient balance stops the purchase. This choice applies only once; change the default in Bank → Default payment method.
strings.Giữ lương thuê người chơi có thể dùng ké: Player wages can be reserved from counter cash/capital, wallet, bank account or joint funds. Canceling an unstarted shift refunds the original source; if joint funds are closed, the payer’s wallet receives the refund.
strings.Lấy huy hiệu Hẹn ở ngày hội thế nào?: How do I earn the Meet at the Festival badge?
strings.Ngày hội xuất hiện ngẫu nhiên ở Chuẩn bị: Festival appears randomly in Preparation. During the same Festival shift in the career needing the badge, finish 3 jobs and 1 minigame using Play now; Practice without rewards does not count.
strings.Trước khi đóng ca, bấm Mở góc ngày hội r: Before closing the shift, choose Open festival stand, then Claim badge in your Passport. Its guidance card shows your current progress.
strings.Mời bạn bè vào làm ở quầy thế nào?: How do I invite friends to work at my counter?
strings.Mở Quầy của bạn → Người → Thuê người chơ: Open Your counters → People → Hire a player, choose a friend and Send invitation. You can invite them as soon as you become friends.
strings.Bạn được mời mở Quầy cần người để nhận c: The invited friend opens Counters hiring to accept the shift. If a public shift is waiting for someone, cancel it before sending a private invitation. A counter can have only one waiting or active shift.
strings.Nhận nuôi em bé, nuôi mèo hoặc cún ở đâu: Where can I adopt a baby, cat or dog?
strings.Từ ngày sống 10, mở Nhà của bạn → Gia đì: From life day 10, open Your home → Family · Pets. Choose one baby and one cat or dog, name them and confirm adoption.
strings.Ăn, vệ sinh và chơi là ba mục chăm sóc m: Feeding, hygiene and play are the three daily care tasks. Babies grow after 5 and 20 cared-for days and have outfits to choose from. Your family is saved per character, with no automatic charges while away.
strings.Đi làm tóc, làm nail hoặc DIY cho mình ở: Where can I get my hair or nails done, or do DIY?
strings.Mở Nhà của bạn → Gia đình · Thú cưng → Đ: Open Your home → Family · Pets → Beauty outings · DIY. You visit as a customer and do not need to start a work shift.
strings.Chọn kiểu tóc, mẫu móng hoặc món DIY, xe: Choose a hairstyle, nail design or DIY item, preview it and check the price before confirming. Your nail designs and crafts are saved to view later.
strings.Quầy lời, lỗ và nộp thuế ra sao?: How do counter profits, losses and taxes work?
strings.Mở Sổ quầy & an toàn để xem doanh thu, h: Open Counter ledger & safety to view revenue, goods/wages/utilities/delivery, space rental, supplies, security, taxes and losses. Profit includes all these deductions; inactive days and offline time incur no fees.
strings.Thuế xu trong game tính chung mọi quầy c: In-game coin taxes combine all counters owned by the same player every 30 life days. VAT is 2% of revenue above 1,000 coins; income tax is 5% of profit after VAT above 200 coins.
strings.Lỗ bù vào lãi cùng kỳ, hoàn tối đa thuế: Losses offset profit in the same period, refunding at most the income tax already paid. Space rental, cleaning and security are expenses, not taxes. These are in-game coin rates.
strings.Ngày bình thường lời vừa phải; sự cố có: Ordinary days earn modest profits; incidents can cause losses. Uncovered expenses pause only that counter; money is not automatically taken from your wallet, bank or other counters.
strings.Trộm, kiểm tra và bảo kê ở quầy xử lý th: How do I handle theft, inspections and extortion at my counter?
strings.Kiểm hàng/vệ sinh và lưu chứng từ bật sẵ: Stock/hygiene checks and keeping documents are enabled by default. Passing an inspection incurs no fine; disabling preparations can create violations. Hygiene violations pause a counter; re-enable stock checks to remedy them.
strings.Bảo vệ tốn 2 xu mỗi ngày bán; bảo vệ hoặ: Security costs 2 coins per selling day; security or a safe reduces theft/robbery losses. Reporting to police may recover some money.
strings.Bị đòi bảo kê: lưu bằng chứng và báo côn: Facing extortion: save evidence and report to police, or refuse; payment is optional. At most one counter in your chain faces a business incident each day.
strings.Phát triển nghề shipper thế nào?: How do I develop my courier career?
strings.Mở Sổ shipper ở Hành trình hoặc Quầy của: Open Courier ledger in Journey or Your counters. Unlock the Delivery career first; choose a contract and check its preparation fee before accepting.
strings.Giao đủ đơn mới phù hợp trong nghề rồi n: Deliver enough new qualifying orders in the career, then claim the contract reward. Per-order delivery fees remain separate; late or incorrect orders reduce rewards. Repeated taps never count an order twice.
strings.Hoàn tất 3 rồi 10 hợp đồng để lên bậc. T: Complete 3, then 10 contracts to advance. An insulated bag and raincoat reduce quality deductions, but do not waive traffic fines. Canceling a contract does not refund its preparation fee.
strings.Đi qua đèn đỏ và học lái máy bay thế nào: How do red lights and flying lessons work?
strings.Khi tự lái giao hàng hoặc giao đơn quầy,: When driving deliveries or counter orders yourself, wait for green at a signal or choose to continue. Crossing on red costs 12 coins once for that intersection; waiting is free.
strings.Khi tự bay, mở hướng dẫn để xem mục tiêu: When flying yourself, open the lessons to see each stage’s target, controls and recovery advice. You can reopen the lessons or choose Quick flight.
strings.🏪 Mở bao nhiêu quầy tùy vốn ở [[Quầy của: 🏪 Open as many counters as your capital allows in [[Your counters]], with no counter limit. Sell yourself if no one is hired; staff sell when you finish a life day.
strings.Chỉ chọn điều đã quan sát hoặc thực sự x: Select only what you observed or what actually happened, not every option. “Nail clipping caused bleeding” applies only if an accident occurred; “Service stopped” only if you stopped. Choose your statements, then press Save report before returning the pet.
strings.Két chưa đủ chỗ nhận tiền ca. Thu két rồ: The till cannot receive this shift payment yet. Collect the till and try again.
strings.Lương đã giữ trước từ nguồn ghi trên biê: The wage was already reserved from the source shown on this receipt. Cash received deducts tax only; wages, goods and rent are not charged again. Shift profit includes the reserved wage. Receipts are separate from your own sales days and count toward the owner’s shared tax totals.
strings.🚦 Đèn vừa chuyển đỏ: miễn phạt trong 1 g: 🚦 The signal just turned red: no fine during the first second, allowing a safe stop.
strings.🔴 Vừa chuyển đỏ · 1 giây để dừng an toàn: 🔴 Just turned red · 1 second to stop safely
strings.Thả ga, giữ phanh trước cửa có người vẫy: Release the throttle and brake outside the door where someone is waving
strings.Đồ mua ở shop tự xuất hiện ở đây, cùng q: Clothes bought at the shop appear here automatically, along with your basic clothes. Select an item to preview it, then open Wardrobe to wear it.
No clothes in the cabinet yet.
strings.Khóa phiên lạ & báo ngân hàng: Block the unknown session & report to the bank
strings.Miễn phí; khoản đã mất không tự hoàn lại: Free; lost coins are not automatically refunded
strings.Đã khóa phiên lạ và báo ngân hàng. Khoản: The unknown session is blocked and the bank has been notified. The lost coins appear in your account history.
strings.Đổi mã bảo mật & khóa phiên lạ: Change security code & block unknown session
strings.Đã đổi mã bảo mật và khóa phiên lạ. Chặn: Security code changed and unknown session blocked. This hack was prevented; no coins were lost.
strings.Có phiên đăng nhập lạ. Khóa ngay miễn ph: An unknown session has signed in. Block it now for free to prevent losing coins from your current account.
strings.Kẻ gian đã chuyển mất một phần xu trong: Someone stole coins from your current account. Savings and joint funds were not charged.
strings.Bảo hiểm hiện tại không bồi thường vụ ha: Current insurance policies do not cover account hacking.
strings.Ngân hàng tránh mất tiền mặt do móc túi;: Bank deposits avoid cash pickpocketing; the account can still be hacked.
strings.Khóa phiên lạ khi được cảnh báo để chặn: Block the unknown session when warned to prevent the hack for free.
strings.Ngân hàng bị hack thì mất tiền thế nào?: What happens to my coins if my bank account is hacked?
strings.Đôi khi có cảnh báo đăng nhập lạ trước 1: An unusual sign-in warning may arrive 1–2 life days in advance. Open Insurance & risks → Change security code & block unknown session to prevent the hack for free.
strings.Bỏ qua cảnh báo: mất 8% số dư tài khoản: Ignoring the warning costs 8% of your current account balance at the time, up to 3,000 coins and subject to shared risk limits. Your wallet, savings, cards and joint fund are not charged.
strings.Khoản mất được ghi trong lịch sử ngân hà: The loss is recorded in bank history. Reporting does not automatically refund coins; current insurance does not cover it. Incidents only occur on life-day ticks when closing shifts, never while offline.
strings.Khóa phiên lạ & báo công an: Block unknown session & report to the police
strings.Công an bắt kẻ hack, hoàn tiền: Police caught the hacker; coins refunded
strings.Công an chưa bắt được kẻ hack: Police have not caught the hacker
strings.🚔 Vụ hack ngân hàng: công an chưa bắt đư: 🚔 Bank hacking case: the police have not caught the culprit or recovered the coins.
strings.🚔 Tiền hoàn đang chờ: cần tài khoản ngân: 🚔 Refund pending: you need a bank account with room below its balance limit to receive it on the next life day.
strings.Bấm Khóa phiên lạ & báo công an: sau 2 n: Tap Block unknown session & report to the police: results arrive after 2 life days. There is a 30% chance of catching the hacker and refunding the full loss to your account, recorded in bank history.
Current insurance does not cover hacking. After 3 life days, the incident card automatically blocks the session and reports it. Life days advance when closing shifts, never while offline.
strings.Hồ sơ cũ đang chờ nhận tiền. Rút bớt tiề: Earlier cases are waiting for refunds. Withdraw some coins if your account is full; this hacking case is kept for a later report.
strings.So phiếu miễn phí: không tính lỗi, không: Checking is free: no mistakes and no time passes. Serving the wrong drink or discarding it still counts as a mistake.
strings.Ly chưa khớp phiếu: soi lại trà, siro, t: The cup does not match the order: check tea, syrup, toppings, size, sugar and ice. Checking does not count as a mistake.
strings.Đã có lịch xét bậc ở đầu ca sau: Your review is scheduled for the start of the next shift
strings.Không bao giờ bị giáng chức. Ngày chưa t: You are never demoted. A day that is not good does not add to good days and still counts toward your workday ratio.
Today did not qualify as a good day.

strings.🧭 Mở [[Đổi nơi làm]], đi tới nơi muốn là: 🧭 Open [[Change workplace]], walk to a workplace and tap [[Continue]] or [[Enter]]. In [[List]], tap [[Continue]] or [[Start]].
strings.✨ Thẻ Truyện nghề ghi điều kiện cho đoạn: ✨ Workplace story cards show the next episode's requirements: tasks, workdays and waiting time at that workplace. Completed requirements are marked.

strings.Em vẫn nhớ ly trà gừng hôm đó. Có người: I still remember that ginger tea. Knowing someone cared helped me feel less stressed.
strings.“Từng trang một thôi” vẫn là hình nền củ: “One page at a time” is still my wallpaper. Whenever I feel discouraged, I reread what you wrote on the lid.
strings.Mình đã hứa đi tìm linh kiện cho Ông Bảy: I promised to look for parts for Mr Bảy. Now there's news, I should tell him right away.
strings.Mình đã nói thật là khó với Ông Bảy. Có: I told Mr Bảy honestly that it would be difficult. We found a tube, but we need to test it before giving him a definite answer.
I wrote on the tube box: “For someone who keeps their word.” You went looking, just as you promised.
strings.Ông ghi lên hộp đèn: “Gửi người thợ nói: I wrote on the tube box: “For an honest craftsperson.” Thank you for explaining every step to me.

strings.Linh chép câu trên nắp ly vào công thức: Linh copied the words from the lid onto the Exam Season Tea recipe: “One page at a time.”
strings.Ông Bảy ghi lên hộp đèn: “Gửi người giữ: Mr Bảy wrote on the tube box: “For someone who keeps their word.” A reminder of your promise to find the parts.
strings.Ông Bảy ghi lên hộp đèn: “Gửi người thợ: Mr Bảy wrote on the tube box: “For an honest craftsperson.” A reminder of your honesty when taking on the radio repair.
strings.Em viết “Từng trang một thôi” vào công t: I wrote “One page at a time” on the recipe. The words on the lid are now a message for next year's students.
strings.Ngày tốt: ca thường xong từ 2 việc, đánh: Good day: regular shifts complete at least 2 tasks, with a daily rating of at least ★3.5 when available. Office careers use the reliable-day result; management shifts need quality of at least 60%.

strings.Về ở chung có lời mời và xác nhận; dùng: Moving in together now needs an invitation and confirmation. Share furniture, keep your own home, and receive the correct rental deposit refund.
strings.Bỏ giới hạn 60 món nội thất! TV và sofa: The 60-item furniture limit is gone! TVs and sofas now have front and back views so you can arrange your home your way.
